_comment: Current itinerary, written by the app after every add, edit or delete. Committed so a fresh database -- the static build, a new clone -- ends up with the same stops and legs instead of just the baseline in app/seed.py.

places.name: Delhi
places.blurb: Where it starts. Red-eye out of Terminal 3.

places.name: Bangkok
places.blurb: Temples at sunrise, Chinatown at midnight, and the best pad thai on the planet at Thipsamai. Base for the first two nights.

places.name: Koh Samui
places.blurb: Island vibes, golden beaches, and a BnB with the crew. Train from Bangkok to Surat Thani, then ferry across. Dates are an estimate -- no confirmation document for this stay yet.

places.name: Phuket
places.blurb: Last stop. Patong nightlife, Kata beach, and the flights home. Dates are an estimate -- no confirmation document for this stay yet.
